profileEvidence.summary: Serious and watchful on its own ground, the Pastore Italiano is a guardian shaped by work with livestock in central Italy. Its selection centre describes a dog that patrols its territory yet stays close to its handler when away from home. Piero Accettella began selecting the population in 1975; it took its Italian Shepherd name in the 1990s.

profileEvidence.summary: Loyal and inclined to stay near its handler, the Canis Panther is bred for watchfulness and personal protection. Its intended character combines attentiveness with patience and composure, although drives and reactions vary with the line and individual. The American project began around 1974, drawing together several working breeds rather than preserving one older breed unchanged.
